name: Export text to HTML
description: Converts recognized image text into editable HTML elements with CSS positioning, typography, and optional image assets.

fields.name: grouping
fields.description: Controls how OCR words and lines become HTML elements. Paragraphs consolidates compatible neighboring OCR results into editable text blocks; lines and words preserve progressively finer geometry.

options.name: Paragraphs
options.description: Combines compatible words and lines into paragraph-level HTML elements.

options.name: Lines
options.description: Creates one positioned HTML element per detected text line.

options.name: Words
options.description: Creates one positioned HTML element per detected word for maximum geometric fidelity.

fields.name: absolute_positioning
fields.description: When enabled, emits CSS coordinates that reproduce each text block's image-space position. When disabled, emits text in document flow and cannot preserve the original layout exactly.

fields.name: include_background
fields.description: Includes the erased or original image as a background asset behind the exported HTML text so non-text artwork remains visible.

fields.name: responsive_conversion
fields.description: Attempts to translate fixed image-space coordinates into responsive layout rules. This improves resizing behavior but may alter exact pixel alignment.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Represents the generated archive containing HTML, CSS, and referenced image or font assets.

action.name: Generate HTML
action.description: Transforms current OCR results and selected typography into an HTML/CSS document and packages all required assets.
